papers.title_in_file: Layers of planar hexagonal heterostructures modeled by quantum graphs
papers.what_it_is: A mathematics PhD thesis (UFSCar, 2022) that models graphene and hexagonal boron nitride layers and their stacks as periodic quantum graphs with a Schroedinger operator, and analyses Dirac cones, parabolic touches and gaps in the dispersion relation, with and without a magnetic field.
papers.why_not: The thesis is spectral theory of Schroedinger operators on periodic quantum graphs for 2D hexagonal materials (graphene, hBN). It has no quantum computing workload, no machine learning, no finance or fraud content and no evaluation method, so it fits none of the contexts qml, qc, ml, world or method. The brief holds no stored assertions from it, so there are no verdicts to give.
